_about: Walks out of cloning facilities, one per facility, recorded by a player walking it once (scripts/capture_session.py). Points are world (x, z); 'spawn' is where you appear after cloning; 'heights' are the HUD heights along the way (not used yet).

theed.note: More than one clone tube: 16 Nov Marc also woke at (-4874, 4031). The walk starts from the nearest route point, whichever tube.
